intent: The champion skill is terse: it tells the agent to read instructions/tests, implement the stub, run tests, and submit. Both held-in tasks (python/beer-song, python/scale-generator) already pass, and the champion is the baseline contract being improved — the goal is to sharpen it so future (held-out) exercises are solved more reliably without regressing what already works. This revision keeps the same essential workflow but adds concrete robustness guidance that generalizes to any exercise: (1) survey the working directory first to locate the actual stub(s), since exercises differ in file layout and module structure; (2) explicit attention to exact output/format (whitespace, line endings, trailing spaces), which is a common failure mode for string-rendering exercises where a near-correct answer still fails; (3) read the test file carefully to extract function signatures and return types rather than guessing the contract; (4) iterate fix-one-failure-at-a-time and re-run the full suite to green, including fixing import/signature crashes before logic; and (5) verify with a final full-suite run before submitting. These are task-agnostic process improvements intended to raise pass rate on harder held-out exercises while preserving behavior on the already-passing held-in tasks.
